result.summary: Designed the GH-501 / ISS-0173 fix as a Type E novel-work artefact at src/design/iss0173-gh501-jwks-zig016-fix.md (35,509 bytes). All 6 deliverables covered. Orphan-fate decision: DELETE (State A). Rationale grounded in the workspace caller census: Get-ChildItem -Recurse -Include *.zig,*.ts,*.tsx with Select-String -Pattern '\boidc_jwks\b' returns exactly ONE hit — src/main.zig:78 itself — proving the re-export has zero callers and the file is functionally dead. The real JWKS concern (src/identity/provider/oidc/jwks_cache.zig) covers a different feature (key IDs per JWKS URI, NOT token validation cache) and is NOT a substitute; deleting src/oidc/jwks.zig does NOT duplicate functionality. State B (KEEP + RENAME + Io-thread) is fully designed as the fallback (10 specific ArrayList unmanaged sites with code diffs; std.Io.Mutex refactor with API verification against installed Zig 0.16 lib/std/Io.zig:1587-1648; lockUncancelable(io) chosen for hot path; lock-ordering invariant 'cache first, denylist second' documented; 8 wrapper signatures updated to thread io: std.Io as first parameter) but is rejected for this run because State A is functionally equivalent and lower-risk. Deliberate-mutation regression plan has three phases (pre-flight baseline RED proof, post-deletion GREEN proof, Phase 3 deliberate re-add of the re-export line to confirm RED with 'file not found'). Lego classification: Type E overall — every change is novel (mechanical find/replace doesn't fit Type A/B/C/D, and the orphan-fate decision is architectural). Two follow-up ISSes surfaced: ISS-0174 for a linter that detects dead pub const re-exports in src/main.zig (SHOULD-2 from diagnosis).

issues.description: SHOULD-2 from diagnosis: codebase lacks a linter that detects dead pub const X = @import(...) re-exports in src/main.zig. The MUST-8 finding in this run was discovered only by manual grep; a future ISS-0172-class blind spot in a different subsystem would re-occur unless automated. Recommend: file ISS-0174 (separate WF-03 run) to add a tools/lint_dead_reexports.py check that greps every pub const re-export in src/main.zig and reports MAJOR if zero callers exist. Out of scope for GH-501; do not bundle here.
